Variants.Content: Driftwood Hall is located on Skagos Island off the east coast of the North. It is a major settlement for local tribes and lords. Skaggs is nominally subordinate to Winterfell, but is separated by trembling seas, dangerous shores and ancient customs; driftwood, fishing, stone and offshore navigation form the basis of survival here.
Entry Driftwood Hall Local families also rely on water, roads, arable land, herds, and markets where goods can be exchanged; if any road, well, or dock fails, the price falls first on them.
Entry Driftwood Hall Entry Driftwood Hall

Entry Driftwood Hall They also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the known world; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but real distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hoof.
Entry Driftwood Hall Entry Driftwood Hall

Entry Driftwood Hall If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

From workshops to sanctuaries, the Driftwood Hall juxtaposes shipbuilding logs, canvas, salt, fish catches and wind-proof stones with local gods, ancestral graves and taboos passed down through generations. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Driftwood Hall They care about water sources, roads, cultivated land, herds, and markets where goods can be exchanged. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
